title: Typed Skill Definition
description: Primary artifact of a typed skill. Defines identity, typed contracts (input/output schemas), adapters, invariants, and composition edges. The companion SKILL.md teaches the agent how to perform the NLP-to-schema mapping.
$comment: Reconciled 2026-05-31 with the actual library convention: identity/maintenance fields are FLAT at top level (status/authors/tags/files/depends_on/peer_skills), matching every other skill and scripts/check-skill-metadata.py. The nested `meta` block is retained as an optional legacy form; new typed skills use the flat fields.

name.description: Kebab-case identifier. Must match directory name and SKILL.md frontmatter.

version.description: Semver. Patch = prose changes. Minor = new optional fields or adapters. Major = breaking schema changes.

description.description: Trigger description for skill routing. Should be pushy — include direct triggers, indirect phrasings, synonyms.

domain.description: Primary domain. Determines position in composition chains.

interface.description: The typed contract. What enters, what exits, what tunes behavior.

adapters.description: Explicit bridges to other skills. Every cross-skill type mismatch requires a named adapter.

inbound.description: Transform other skills' output into this skill's input.

outbound.description: Transform this skill's output into other skills' input.

invariants.description: Properties that hold for every valid output regardless of input.

composition.description: Declared edges in the skill pipeline graph.

upstream.description: Skills whose output this skill can consume.

downstream.description: Skills that can consume this skill's output.

peer.description: Skills that operate alongside without producer-consumer relationship.

files.description: All files in the skill directory (relative paths).
All .md/.json files in the skill dir (relative paths). Flat, matching scripts/check-skill-metadata.py.

$ref.description: Path to JSON Schema file. Use './schemas/input.json' for local, 'shared://primitives/OKLCHColor' for shared library.

description.description: What this schema represents in domain terms.

reason.description: The design judgment behind dropping this field.

enforcement.description: 'schema' = encoded in JSON Schema (cheapest). 'runtime' = eval assertion. 'convention' = instruction-only (last resort).

schema_path.description: If 'schema' enforcement, the path where the constraint is encoded.
